# First Mate

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054)</sub>
- **Nicknames:** Matey  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P15](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0015)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  <sub>[v4 CHAPTER 40 FAREWELL TO THE HOUSE OF DREAMS P5](../source/v04-c40.md#nw-v04-c40-p0005)</sub>

## Appearance

The First Mate is a gorgeous, huge orange-colored cat with a face as round as a full moon and vivid, brilliant green eyes. He possesses immense, white, double paws and is described as so large, warm, velvety, and effulgent that he can curl up into a big golden ball.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P25](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0025), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P37](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0037), [v4 CHAPTER 14 NOVEMBER DAYS P2](../source/v04-c14.md#nw-v04-c14-p0002), [v4 CHAPTER 16 NEW YEAR’S EVE AT THE LIGHT P7](../source/v04-c16.md#nw-v04-c16-p0007), [v4 CHAPTER 24 THE LIFE-BOOK OF CAPTAIN JIM P30](../source/v04-c24.md#nw-v04-c24-p0030), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P39](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0039)_

## Personality

The First Mate is known for his friendly and talkative nature, possessing a sociable heart that makes him an agreeable companion to converse with.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 7 THE SCHOOLMASTER’S BRIDE P54](../source/v04-c07.md#nw-v04-c07-p0054)_

## History

The First Mate was an abandoned cat who was rescued from the branches of a tree on a bitter cold winter day by Captain Jim. He spent his life residing with Captain Jim at the [Four Winds](../codex/places.md#four-winds) lighthouse. As Captain Jim grew older and reflected on his mortality, he asked [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) to promise that she would care for the First Mate after he was gone.

_Sources: [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P42](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0042), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P46](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0046), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P51](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0051), [v4 CHAPTER 9 AN EVENING AT FOUR WINDS POINT P57](../source/v04-c09.md#nw-v04-c09-p0057), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P6](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0006), [v4 CHAPTER 35 POLITICS AT FOUR WINDS P24](../source/v04-c35.md#nw-v04-c35-p0024), +2 more_
